correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently recomputed normalized simplex determinants for every one of 4368 unordered five-cube-vertex subsets: zero-volume 1360, volumes 1,2,3 multiplicities 2672,320,16. The 4-by-4 parity monomial matrix and factored polynomial match the actual source. Every facet sum is half the total weight, giving the exact ratio; symbolic derivatives in squared correlations are strictly negative, proving uniqueness and sharpness for all positive parameters. The 4368-case census is exhaustive for this finite coefficient polynomial, while the derivative argument, not sampling, proves the continuum inequality. The correction is strictly historical/interpretive, not to the validated exact identity.
